findings.evidence: mathlib PiTensorProduct/Basic.lean:927 `instance : AddCommGroup (⨂[R] i, s i)`; TensorPower/Basic.lean:37 `abbrev TensorPower`; TensorCoalgebra/Coaugmented/Basic.lean:79 `abbrev TensorWords := ⨁ n, TensorPower R n M`; TensorProduct/Basic.lean:360,389 `[AddCommGroup M] [AddCommMonoid N] … instance addCommGroup : AddCommGroup (M ⊗[R] N)`.
findings.fix: Delete the local instance and `homCochainsAddCommGroup`. Rely on the global instances: the PiTensorProduct instance, `DirectSum.addCommGroup`, `TensorProduct.addCommGroup` and `Submodule.addCommGroup`. If synthesis genuinely fails, give one canonical public instance in the bar-carrier file and use it in both `Bimodule/Hom/Basic` and here.
findings.issue: The local `AddCommGroup ((TensorWords R A ⊗[R] X) ⊗[R] TensorWords R B)` built from `Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup R` duplicates an instance Mathlib already provides. Public statements are elaborated against it: `sub_negOnePow_smul_mem_homCochains`, `homDifferential`, `coe_homDifferential` and `homDifferential_comp`. So is the exported `homCochainsAddCommGroup` (line 91). Importing files instead synthesize the global instance, whose negation is not reducibly the `(-1)•` negation, so rewriting with these lemmas may fail.

findings.evidence: grep: Module/Right/Hom/Complex.lean:281 `theorem homDifferential_comp_homDifferential`, :440 `def homComplexXEquiv`, :444 `theorem homComplexXEquiv_d`. None of these appear in Bimodule/Hom/Complex.lean.
findings.fix: Add `homComplexXEquiv (p) : (homComplex MM NN).X p ≃ₗ[R] homCochains MM NN p`, `homComplexXEquiv_d` and `homDifferential_comp_homDifferential (p) : homDifferential MM NN (p+1) ∘ₗ homDifferential MM NN p = 0`, mirroring Module/Right/Hom/Complex.lean:281,440,444.
findings.issue: `homComplex` is `@[expose]` and consumers have to reduce `.X p` to `homCochains` by defeq. The right-module complex instead exports `homComplexXEquiv` and `homComplexXEquiv_d`, and its consumers use them (Module/Right/Yoneda.lean:500–580). The linear-map form `homDifferential_comp_homDifferential` is also missing; the right-module complex uses it for `homComplex` and for homology.

summary: A file-local AddCommGroup instance on the bar carriers duplicates instances Mathlib already provides, and it is baked into public statements and an exported named instance. The Hom complex also lacks the X-equivalence and linear-map square-zero API that the parallel right-module complex exposes and its consumers use.
